control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant

facts.title: audit finding - management of change not applied to B-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on B-8201 and TT-8201 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant on B-8201 and TT-8201 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. B-8201 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 20 February 2021 a planned critical control verification of B-8201 and TT-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch not effective.
